calc.title: Cost calculator
calc.lead: Enter your usage to estimate the monthly cost of each model. Everything is calculated locally in your browser.
calc.noResults: No models can be calculated (both input and output prices are required).
calc.formula: Monthly cost = (uncached input × input price + cached input × cached input price + output × output price) ÷ 1,000,000. For tiered pricing, the tier is chosen by input tokens per request.
about.title: About
about.lead: AI API Price Board fetches public pricing pages and open price databases every day at about 08:00 Beijing Time, validates them and publishes the results.
about.quarantine.lead: Offerings with unusually large price changes are held in quarantine and published only after repeated confirmation. The site keeps showing the previous price meanwhile.
about.fx.body: 1 USD = {rate} CNY ({date}, source: {provider}). Converted prices are for reference only.
about.method.unit: All prices are per 1M tokens and stored in the vendor's original currency. Converted prices are prefixed with ≈.
about.method.blended: Blended price = (3 × input + 1 × output) ÷ 4, used for the default sort order.
about.method.stale: When a source fails, the last successfully fetched prices are kept and marked with ⚠.
about.disclaimer.body: Prices on this site are fetched automatically and may be delayed or wrong. Prices are for reference only. Please check official sites. This site is not affiliated with any listed vendor.
about.api.body: All data is available for free through static JSON endpoints:

media.note: Prices come from vendor-direct entries in the open LiteLLM price list and from OpenRouter's video API, and only cover models billed per second or per image. Video models billed per token (such as Seedance) are converted to per-second prices assuming 16:9 and 24 fps; image models billed purely per token are not listed.
